description: Modern mod manager for Thunderstore. Profiles, one-click installs from thunderstore.io, r2modman profile codes.
notes: Update Gale with 'scoop update Gale', not with its own updater: the in-app update
runs the upstream MSI, which installs a second copy for all users in Program Files.
Gale keeps its settings and profiles in %APPDATA%\com.kesomannen.gale and its cache
in %LOCALAPPDATA%\com.kesomannen.gale; 'scoop uninstall -p' does not delete them.
'Install with Mod Manager' on thunderstore.io (ror2mm:// and gale:// links) works after
Gale has been started once: Gale registers these links for the current user itself.
To open .r2z profile files with Gale, execute:
pre_install: # Upstream's MSI (also run by its in-app updater and by games/gale) installs Gale for all users in Program Files.

$msiCopy = Get-ChildItem $roots -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Get-ItemProperty -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { ($_.DisplayName -eq 'Gale') -and ($_.Publisher -eq 'kesomannen') } | Select-Object -First 1

error "Gale $($msiCopy.DisplayVersion) is already installed from upstream's MSI ($($msiCopy.InstallLocation)). Uninstall it first in Settings > Apps (from an elevated shell: msiexec /x $($msiCopy.PSChildName)); your profiles in %APPDATA%\com.kesomannen.gale stay. Scoop has already downloaded and unpacked ${app}: run 'scoop uninstall $app' or simply install again, which cleans that up."

if ($msiCopy) { warn "A second copy of Gale from upstream's MSI is installed ($($msiCopy.InstallLocation)), probably by Gale's own updater. Uninstall it in Settings > Apps and update with 'scoop update $app'." }
post_install: warn "Registry templates not found in '$templates', the .r2z file association is unavailable."

script: # Gale registers ror2mm:// and gale:// for the current user on every start; drop them only if they point to this copy.
